name: Forced displacement
summary: No new 500,000+ displacement event; cyclone evacuations under way in India
state: UNHCR puts global forced displacement above 122 million. No single new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month had been found as of 2 Nov; Odisha and Andhra Pradesh are evacuating coastal areas ahead of Cyclone Murasu's landfall on 2–3 Nov, and UNHCR warns displacement in Ukraine is worsening.
